facts.fact: 2011年5月2日（周一），中情局协助让乌萨马·本·拉登“去见上帝”，作者称中情局做了件非常非常好的事。
facts.anchor: When it finally did help Usama bin Muhammad bin Awad bin Johnson come to Jesus on Monday, May 2nd, 2011, CIA did a very, very good thing.

facts.fact: 突袭三天后的2011年5月5日，记者米勒在首篇报道中泄露重大秘密，称中情局在阿伯塔巴德设有一个监视本·拉登宅院的安全屋。
facts.anchor: In his first piece, dated May 5, 2011, just three days after the raid, Miller spilled a huge secret by reporting that CIA had operated an Abbottabad safehouse with eye on bin Ladin’s compound.

facts.fact: 12天后的2011年5月17日，米勒又传递了高度敏感的泄露信息，称中情局用从阿富汗飞来的隐身无人机监视本·拉登宅院。
facts.anchor: Twelve days later, on May 17th, 2011, Miller passed along massively sensitive leaked information

facts.fact: 2011年5月5日的报道称，中情局曾于2010年12月向国会申请，在各部门预算内重新划拨数千万美元来资助该行动。
facts.anchor: the CIA went to Congress in December to secure authority to reallocate tens of millions of dollars within assorted agency budgets to fund it

facts.fact: 2003年的吹牛冠军声称自己监管的直属下属太多，不得不再雇2361名直属下属，以便正式下属休弹性假时顶班。
facts.anchor: he had to hire an additional 2,361 direct reports to fill in when his regular ones took their Flex Day.

facts.fact: 中情局花钱雇用两名前军方“心理学家”及其公司，支付8000万美元来创建并运行严酷审讯项目。
facts.anchor: hire and pay two ex-military “psychologists” and their firm $80 million

facts.fact: 中情局93%的员工被称为“经理”，其工作是“管理”另外7%从事关乎国家安全工作的人。
facts.anchor: Those ninety-three percent are called “managers,” and their job is to “manage” the other seven percent whose jobs are vital to national security.

facts.fact: 米勒第二篇文章称，中情局所用的“坎大哈野兽”隐身无人机自2007年起就从阿富汗起飞执行任务。
facts.anchor: having been flying out of Afghanistan since 2007
